prompt:
Image 1 is a style reference only: copy its photographic look, light, colour treatment, depth of field and subject scale. Do not copy its subject or composition.
Use: thumbnail for a travel packing video about ten days with one small bag, shown at 16:9 up to 880x495.
Subject: a small carry-on backpack open on a bed with neatly rolled clothes and packing cubes beside it.
Details: rolled shirts, a toiletry bag, a passport holder with no text, sneakers, soft window light.
Composition: top-down view, the bag in the left half.
Style: a real photograph made for a video thumbnail; natural light, true-to-life colour, slightly bright and saturated, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the subject, clean uncluttered background, the subject large and filling about 70% of the frame, eye-level or slightly high camera.
Constraints: no text, no letters or numbers, no captions, no logos or trademarks, no watermark, no frame or border, no faces looking at the camera, no recognisable real people.
alt: An open carry-on backpack on a bed, packed with rolled clothes, with packing cubes, a toiletry bag and sneakers beside it.
